s: June 7, 2017 - My SIL has a ring from James Allen. It's excellent quality and they are a good value seller for diamonds. The diamond will be as high quality as its ratings suggest. I'd be sure to take full advantage of the videos / photos of the stone before you buy, since some of the middle clarity rating diamonds CAN actually have visible inclusions, if you're not careful (this is true for all providers, just harder to tell when you buy online than in person).
